provenance.method: pipeline/rbi_extract.js run in a browser tab on https://rbidocs.rbi.org.in (site requires a JS-capable browser)
provenance.handbook: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy 2025-26 (released 31 Jul 2026): Table 40 (policy rates), 167 (SCB aggregates, monthly), 178 (month-end G-Sec yields), 210 (forex reserves, monthly), 215 (forex reserves, weekly), 205 (exchange rates, monthly average)
provenance.wss: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement Tables 2 (forex reserves), 4 (SCB business), 5 (ratios & rates); issues 2 Jan 2026 - 20 Nov 2026
provenance.policy_2026_10_07: RBI press release prid=63742 (7 Oct 2026): MPC resolution Oct 5-7 2026, repo +25 bp to 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.75%

series.name: Bank credit – scheduled commercial banks
series.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
series.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

series.name: Bank credit growth (y/y)
series.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
series.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

series.name: Aggregate deposits – scheduled commercial banks
series.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
series.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

series.name: Aggregate deposits growth (y/y)
series.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
series.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

series.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth
series.notes: Scheduled commercial banks, y/y growth rates, percentage points. A wider gap means credit is growing faster than deposits; it is not a cash shortfall. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.
series.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)

series.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth, 3-month average
series.notes: Average of the latest three monthly gaps; months with any gap missing are left out. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.
series.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)

series.name: Incremental credit–deposit ratio, financial year to date
series.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
series.notes: Change in bank credit since end-March per ₹100 change in deposits since end-March. Not shown while deposits have grown by less than 0.5% of the end-March stock (or fallen), usually April and May. Compare with the same month of the previous financial year.

series.name: USD/INR – FBIL reference rate (weekly)
series.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
series.notes: Rate on the last trading day of the week, per WSS Table 5.

series.name: Weighted average call money rate (weekly)
series.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
series.notes: Operating target of monetary policy.

series.name: 91-day T-bill primary yield (weekly)
series.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
series.notes: Cut-off yield in the week's auction; gaps where no auction.

series.name: USD/INR – FBIL reference rate (daily)
series.source: RBI – rbi.org.in Current Rates (FBIL reference rate, 1.00 pm)
series.notes: Collected daily from the snapshot since November 2026; dated by RBI's 'as at' date. Earlier weeks come from the Weekly Statistical Supplement series.

series.name: 10-year benchmark G-Sec, traded yield (daily)
series.source: RBI – rbi.org.in Current Rates (G-Sec market)
series.notes: Yield of the listed bond maturing about ten years ahead (currently 6.94% GS 2036). The bond changes when RBI issues a new 10-year benchmark. Not the same measure as FBIL's par yield.

series.name: Call money rate, weighted average (daily)
series.notes: Row A.I 'Call Money'. Days with no call trades (weekends, holidays) are left out.
series.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'

series.name: Overnight money market rate, weighted average (daily)
series.notes: Row A 'Overnight Segment (I+II+III+IV)': call, triparty repo, market repo and repo in corporate bonds.
series.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'

series.name: RBI net liquidity, outstanding including the day's operations
series.notes: Row F. Positive = net injection by RBI, negative = net absorption. Reported on non-trading days too. Net liquidity = Repo + MSF + SLF - Reverse Repo - SDF.
series.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'

series.name: Call money rate minus repo rate (daily)
series.notes: Call money weighted average rate minus the policy repo rate in force that day, in basis points. Trading days only.
series.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'

series.name: Call money rate minus repo rate, 5-trading-day average
series.notes: Average of the latest five trading days.
series.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'

series.name: Weighted average lending rate, fresh rupee loans
series.notes: WALR on loans sanctioned in the month. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.
series.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)

series.name: Weighted average lending rate, outstanding rupee loans
series.notes: WALR on the whole loan book. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.
series.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)

series.name: Weighted average term deposit rate, fresh deposits
series.notes: WADTDR on term deposits raised in the month. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.
series.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)

series.name: Weighted average term deposit rate, outstanding deposits
series.notes: WADTDR on the whole term-deposit book. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.
series.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)

series.name: 1-year MCLR, median across banks
series.notes: Usually one month later than the WALR/WADTDR in the same release. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.
series.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)

series.name: Market pricing indicator: fresh loan rate minus fresh deposit rate
series.source: Derived from RBI lending and deposit rates (fresh WALR minus fresh WADTDR)
series.notes: A market-wide pricing indicator, not a bank's margin: loan mix, funding mix and tenor all affect it.

series.name: CPI General index – Combined (linked estimate)
series.source: India Macro Monitor calculation from MoSPI old and new series
series.notes: All-India general CPI; geometric average of the new/old ratios across the 2025 overlap. Official current-base observations start at 2025-01. Earlier values are our estimate; methodology and coverage changed.

series.name: IIP General index (linked estimate)
series.source: India Macro Monitor calculation from MoSPI old and new series
series.notes: General IIP; geometric average of the new/old ratios over FY 2023-24, using the currently published index. Official current-base observations start at 2023-04. Earlier values are our estimate; methodology and coverage changed.

series.name: Real GDP (quarterly level) (linked estimate)
series.source: India Macro Monitor calculation from MoSPI old and new series
series.notes: Real GDP; ratio of summed quarterly levels over FY 2022-23. Official current-base observations start at 2022-Q1. Earlier values are our estimate; methodology and coverage changed.

series.name: Current account balance
series.source: RBI monthly balance of payments
series.notes: Monthly preliminary or revised balance of payments, signed; a negative figure is a deficit.

series.name: Foreign direct investment, net (BoP)
series.source: RBI monthly balance of payments
series.notes: Net investment in India less net investment abroad, as defined in the release.

series.name: Foreign portfolio investment, net (BoP)
series.source: RBI monthly balance of payments
series.notes: Net portfolio investment in India less net investment abroad, as defined in the release.

series.name: Core consumer price inflation (year on year)
series.source: RBI Bulletin and Monetary Policy Report
series.notes: Published CPI excluding food and fuel. Coverage depends on available cited readings.

series.name: Union government fiscal deficit, financial year to date
series.source: Controller General of Accounts, Union Government Accounts at a Glance
series.notes: Cumulative from April. Provisional figures; April resets the total.

series.name: Gross GST collections (monthly)
series.source: GST Network, gross and net revenue tables
series.notes: Gross domestic and import revenue, before refunds.

series.name: Interest rate on fresh bank housing loans
series.source: RBI Monetary Policy Report, credit transmission table
series.notes: Selected monthly weighted-average lending rates on fresh housing loans, as published by RBI.

series.name: Broad money supply (M3)
series.source: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 6
series.notes: Dated by RBI's reporting date. Repeated readings for one date are consolidated.

series.name: Bank credit growth – agriculture

series.notes: Year-on-year growth for select scheduled commercial banks.

series.name: Bank credit growth – industry
series.source: RBI sectoral deployment of bank credit
series.notes: Year-on-year growth for select scheduled commercial banks.

series.name: Bank credit growth – personal loans
series.source: RBI sectoral deployment of bank credit
series.notes: Year-on-year growth for select scheduled commercial banks.

series.name: Bank credit growth – services

series.name: Merchandise trade balance
series.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry monthly trade release
series.notes: Merchandise exports less imports. Excludes services; a negative figure is a deficit.

series.name: Wholesale prices (all commodities)
series.source: DPIIT Office of Economic Adviser
series.notes: Latest observations can be provisional.

series.name: Wholesale price inflation (year on year)
series.source: Calculated from the DPIIT all-commodities WPI
series.notes: Calculated from the published rounded index, so may differ slightly from the published inflation rate.

series.name: Repo rate less trailing inflation
series.source: Calculated from RBI policy rate history and MoSPI consumer price inflation
series.notes: Month-end repo rate minus the same month's year-on-year CPI inflation, in percentage points. A backward-looking proxy for the real policy rate.
